excerpt: Figure 1 describes QEE quantum modules that receive prepared states, compute expectation values <H_i>, pass those values to a CPU, and let a classical minimization algorithm compute <H> and determine new state parameters that are fed back to the quantum processing unit.
overview: The figure caption gives the concrete control-flow evidence for the hybrid algorithm: the quantum processor estimates measurable terms and the classical processor performs aggregation and optimization. This supports the claim that QVE is not a standalone quantum circuit but a closed-loop quantum-classical variational procedure.
title: Hybrid Feedback Architecture
